outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Women who delivered at Sultan Qaboos University Hospital (SQUH) by vacuum or forceps between June 2015 and March 2018
finding: OVD is associated with fewer maternal and neonatal complications compared to cesarean section when performed by a well-trained obstetrician, with varying outcomes depending on the instrument used.
mod_finding: The use of Kiwi OmniCup vacuum was associated with a higher proportion of neonatal admissions to the NICU.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was significantly higher in the metallic vacuum cup group.
